## D — Accuracy and source controls for Turning merging and passing
The turning merging and passing facts are authored from the selected official physical pages and preserve the actor, triggering condition and exceptions described there.
Source confidence is high for page fidelity; current legal applicability is limited by the old edition and recorded freshness debt.
Image-only information has not been converted into unsupported facts; any diagram-dependent learning surface needs its own evidence review.
The preaccept fact-check receipt is same-model review only; independent coverage and fact QA remain pending.
A printed shoulder-passing statement conflicts with another prohibition and is withheld for current official legal resolution (verify PA-TURNS-SHOULDER-CONFLICT).
Dated teen crash counts are historical evidence rather than current learner rules (verify PA-TURNS-HISTORICAL).

corpus_stability.reason: The issuer currently links the PUB 95 (4-21) handbook; no frequent-rewrite evidence is asserted. Edition age and absent effective date remain accuracy debt in part A.

verification_debt.claim_text: Physical51 printed47 says that when passing a left-turning driver on the right the passing driver must stay on the berm or shoulder, but also prohibits passing on the shoulder of a multilane highway. Page image confirms the printed wording; neither an on/off correction nor a general shoulder-passing permission is asserted.
Physical49 has2017 teen-turning crash data; physical51 has2013–2017 wrong-side crash and death counts. These dated statistics remain historical source evidence.
